sql_calls.sql:
SELECT f.date, f.forecast_units_per_day, f.sigma, f.book_on_hand, f.on_order, f.ordered_units, f.method,
       s.units_sold, b.book_on_hand_close
FROM store.forecasts f
LEFT JOIN store.daily_sales s ON s.date = f.date AND s.sku = f.sku
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book b ON b.date = f.date AND b.sku = f.sku
WHERE f.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND f.date >= DATE '2026-05-25'
  AND f.date < DATE '2026-07-02'
ORDER BY f.date;

SELECT
  (SELECT MIN(date) FROM store.daily_sales) AS sales_min_date,
  (SELECT MAX(date) FROM store.daily_sales) AS sales_max_date,
  (SELECT MIN(date) FROM store.forecasts) AS forecast_min_date,
  (SELECT MAX(date) FROM store.forecasts) AS forecast_max_date,
  (SELECT MIN(bill_ts) FROM store.pos_lines) AS pos_min_ts,
  (SELECT MAX(bill_ts) FROM store.pos_lines) AS pos_max_ts,
  (SELECT MIN(audit_ts) FROM store.shelf_audits) AS audit_min_ts,
  (SELECT MAX(audit_ts) FROM store.shelf_audits) AS audit_max_ts,
  (SELECT MIN(count_ts) FROM store.stock_counts) AS count_min_ts,
  (SELECT MAX(count_ts) FROM store.stock_counts) AS count_max_ts;

sql_calls.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(units_sold) AS bags_sold,
  SUM(revenue_inr) AS revenue_inr,
  COUNT(*) AS daily_rows,
  MIN(date) AS first_date,
  MAX(date) AS last_date,
  SUM(CASE WHEN units_sold = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_sales_days
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
  AND date < DATE '2026-07-01';

SELECT 'goods_receipt' AS record_type, received_ts::text AS ts, grn_id AS ref, sku_booked AS sku, units_booked AS units, receipt_method AS detail
FROM store.goods_receipts
WHERE (sku_booked = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' OR asn_sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG')
  AND received_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-05-25'
  AND received_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-02'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'write_off', write_off_ts::text, reason, sku, units, reason
FROM store.write_offs
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND write_off_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-05-25'
  AND write_off_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-02'
ORDER BY ts;

sql_calls.sql:
SELECT audit_ts, sku, status
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01'
  AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY audit_ts, sku;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS audits,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') AS on_shelf_audits,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'empty') AS empty_audits,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') / COUNT(*), 2) AS observed_on_shelf_pct
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01'
  AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01';
